scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @pdfdiff/core build && pnpm --filter @pdfdiff/pdfjs-browser build && pnpm --filter @pdfdiff/viewer-react build
scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run typecheck && vite build
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:dry-run: pnpm run build && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --dry-run
scripts.test: pnpm run build && node --test tests/rendered-html.test.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/core.test.ts tests/semantic.test.ts tests/viewer-modes.test.ts tests/region-labels.test.ts tests/region-merge.test.ts
